own_solution.law: For laboratory propagation perpendicular to the source velocity, f_abs = f0/gamma. Thus the frequency decrease is Δf = f0[1-sqrt(1-v²/c²)] ≈ (E0/h)(2πfrotR)²/(2c²).
assumptions: The photon energy is specified in the instantaneous rest frame of the source.
The source remains on the rotor rim when its radius increases.
Only the leading nonzero term in v/c is retained.
